evidence.description: Original Compustat vintage and source period.

evidence.quote: For each year t from 1972 to 1992, we retain all observations with non-missing data for the following:
CapExt is capital expenditures, Compustat data #128,
P and BVE are measured at the end of fiscal year t - 1 because they are used as deflators.
Per share values of P, BVE, and future earnings, Et +1 to Et +5, are adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends using the cumulative adjustment factor, Compustat data 27
Since earnings variability is calculated using data for five years following year t
In cases where EPS data are absent in any of the years from t + 1 through t + 5, SD(Et+1,t+5) is set equal to the mean SD(Et+1,t+5) of the firms in the same Altman Z-Score decile portfolio
We rank the firms according to their Z -scores and assign each observation a decile rank.
We estimate R&D assets in year t as the sum of R&D expenditures for the past years, each depreciated at the rate of 20% per year (i.e., assuming straight line depreciation over five years).
Estimation of capitalized R&D requires five years of R&D expenditures, which reduces the sample size for this analysis from 42,776 to 29,408.
The earliest year is set at 1972 because prior to that year
